newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-ENGLISH CHAMPION HURDLE DECLARED RUNNERS/RIDERS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-ENGLISH CHAMPION HURDLE DECLARED RUNNERS/RIDERS.

text.p: Seventeen runners were declared
on Monday for Tuesday's Champion Hurdle, to be run over two
miles and 110 yards (3.2 kms) at Cheltenham (1515 GMT).
